column4: Kernel walks per-thread IRP list calling IoCancelIrp then writes STATUS 0 to iosb. Sogen synchronous emulator has no pending IRPs; validates handle and writes STATUS_SUCCESS — correct stub. IoCancelIrp token is verbatim in decomp.
Kernel calls IopCancelIoFile for the specific IRP. Sogen delegates to handle_NtCancelIoFile — correct stub for synchronous model. IopCancelIoFile token is verbatim in decomp.
Kernel creates NT object namespace directory. Sogen returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER for null name, STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise — correct DEFER; full object namespace not emulated.

Kernel routes to IopCreateFile. Sogen implements host path translation, create_disposition semantics (COLLISION/NOT_FOUND/SUPERSEDE), console/pipe/device routing, FILE_DELETE_ON_CLOSE access check. Status contracts match the kernel contract.

Kernel calls IopCreateFile with IsNamedPipe=1 and pipe parameters. Sogen creates named_pipe device object capturing pipe_type/read_mode/completion_mode/instances/quotas; builds shared buffer registry for server-client roundtrip; IOSB.Information=FILE_CREATED. Contract matches.

Kernel opens object by name with FILE_DELETE then deletes. Sogen translates path to host path and calls std::filesystem::remove; STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND on absent; STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED on remove failure. Semantics correct.
Kernel is a trivial forwarder to NtFlushBuffersFileEx with zero flags. Sogen delegates to handle_NtFlushBuffersFile which calls fflush; STDOUT handled; invalid handle rejected. Correct.
Kernel calls IopFlushBuffersFile. Sogen calls fflush dropping flags/parameters — adequate for emulation; sync emulator has no dirty page cache. Correct stub.
Kernel routes to IopXxxControlFile. Sogen dispatches to device->execute_ioctl for device handles; resets event on entry; STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE for non-device handles. Correct.

Kernel validates handle, checks access, tries fast-path or allocates IRP with lock range. Sogen maintains per-process file_locks map with exclusive/shared overlap detection using half-open interval math; STATUS_LOCK_NOT_GRANTED on conflict; STATUS_INVALID_LOCK_RANGE on invalid range. Contract matches.

Kernel calls ObOpenObjectByNameEx on ObpDirectoryObjectType. Sogen maps well-known paths (\KnownDlls, \KnownDlls32, \Sessions\1\BaseNamedObjects, \RPC Control) to pseudo-handles; STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED for unknown. Adequate for emulation.
Kernel is a thin wrapper calling IopCreateFile with CreateDisposition=FILE_OPEN. Sogen delegates to handle_NtCreateFile with FILE_OPEN. Semantics match.
Kernel calls ObOpenObjectByNameEx on ObpSymbolicLinkObjectType. Sogen maps KnownDllPath→KNOWN_DLLS_SYMLINK pseudo-handle; STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED for unknown. Adequate for emulation.

Kernel opens file object then queries FileBasicInformation. Sogen uses compat_stat to fill FILE_BASIC_INFORMATION; STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND on absent; attributes DIR/NORMAL set correctly. Contract matches.

Kernel converts ReturnSingleEntry/RestartScan booleans to SL_ flags then calls BuildQueryDirectoryIrp. Sogen converts identically to query_flags and delegates to handle_NtQueryDirectoryFileEx. Correct.

Kernel calls BuildQueryDirectoryIrp then IopSynchronousServiceTail. Sogen walks directory_iterator with wildcard matching; STATUS_NO_MORE_FILES on exhaustion; STATUS_BUFFER_OVERFLOW when first entry doesn't fit; NextEntryOffset chain maintained. Contract matches.

Kernel opens file then populates FILE_NETWORK_OPEN_INFORMATION. Sogen fills all time fields, AllocationSize, EndOfFile, FileAttributes via compat_stat; STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND on absent. Contract matches.

Kernel delegates to IoQueryInformationByName. Sogen handles FileStatBasicInformation via open+fstat; fills times/sizes/attributes; STATUS_BUFFER_OVERFLOW on short buffer; STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND on absent. Contract matches.

Kernel validates class, resolves access, dispatches per info class via IRP. Sogen handles Basic/Standard/Internal/Ea/Access/Position/Mode/Alignment/Name/NormalizedName/Stream/Volume/Compression/AttrTag/IsRemote/RemoteProtocol/Id; STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS for 0 or >=max; STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH on short buffer. Contract matches.

Kernel resolves handle to symlink object, acquires pushlock, copies string checking MaximumLength; sets ReturnedLength. Sogen maps KNOWN_DLLS_SYMLINK→System32, KNOWN_DLLS32_SYMLINK→SysWOW64; STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL on insufficient MaximumLength; ReturnedLength always set. Contract matches.

Kernel dispatches per FS_INFORMATION_CLASS via IRP. Sogen handles Device/Size/FullSize/Volume/Attribute classes; STDOUT→FILE_DEVICE_CONSOLE; others→FILE_DEVICE_DISK with NTFS attributes. Contract matches for supported classes.

Kernel resolves handle then calls IopReadFile. Sogen handles STDIN/NUL/pipe/file; ByteOffset FILE_USE_FILE_POINTER_POSITION sentinel respected; STATUS_END_OF_FILE when length>0 and no data; APC and event delivery on completion. Contract matches.

Kernel validates class, checks access, dispatches via IRP. Sogen handles Basic (no-op)/Rename (defer_rename with root handle)/Disposition/DispositionEx (defer_delete with access check)/Position (seek)/EndOfFile (resize)/Allocation (no-op). Contract matches for implemented classes.
Kernel tries FastIoUnlockSingle then falls back to IRP. Sogen removes matching lock_range from file_locks map by (owner, offset, length, key); STATUS_RANGE_NOT_LOCKED if not found. Contract matches.

Kernel resolves handle via handle table walk then calls IopWriteFile. Sogen handles STDOUT/NUL/pipe/file; FILE_WRITE_TO_END_OF_FILE and FILE_USE_FILE_POINTER_POSITION sentinels supported; IOSB.Information = bytes_written. Contract matches.
